title: Member Premium Percentage Points for Length of Comfort Club Membership, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On an after-hours call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a long-standing Comfort Club member earns points on the member premium percentage. The record read is the first enrollment date on the member's agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, which never changes on renewal.

**Rule.** A member whose agreement was first enrolled 96 or more whole calendar months before the date of handling adds 15 points to the member premium percentage. A member first enrolled 36 to 95 months before adds 10 points. A member first enrolled more recently adds nothing. The points are added to the member premium percentage before the 100 percent ceiling is applied.

| First enrolled, in whole calendar months before the date of handling | Points added |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 15 |
| 36 to 95 | 10 |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

## Boundaries

- 96 whole months adds 15 points. 95 whole months adds 10.
- 36 whole months adds 10 points. 35 whole months adds none.

## Example (hypothetical)

A member first enrolled in March eight years before the date of handling, with 96 or more whole calendar months passed, adds 15 points. A tier percentage of 50 percent would read 65 percent with these points.
